dedupePolicy.semanticLayer: Recovery-generated deployments are operational provenance, not newly recovered source records.
dedupePolicy.canonicalWriteRule: Never append a second canonical record when the primary key or fallback fingerprint already exists; update/merge provenance or skip instead.
dedupePolicy.mirrorRule: Mirror evidence may retain provenance links/checkpoint references but must not increment canonical unique-record counts more than once.
dedupePolicy.selfGeneratedRule: Deployments triggered by rescue/checkpoint commits on backup/pre-vercel-risk-20260914 are classified RECOVERY_OPERATIONAL and excluded from recovered-source-floor counts.
dedupePolicy.checkpointRule: Checkpoint files may reference previously seen evidence for audit continuity, but canonical absorption counts only unique non-self-generated source evidence.
dedupePolicy.conflictRule: If the same key arrives with different state/metadata, preserve one canonical record and merge the newer observation as provenance rather than creating a duplicate row.

postTerminalHead.note: The incremental window closed exactly on the previous watermark. Recovery-generated deployments are preserved but excluded from recovered-source counts, preventing checkpoint-write feedback loops from inflating totals.
